BIOLOGY: Homeostatic regulation of synaptic/intrinsic gain toward a firing-rate set-point (Turrigiano 2011; Desai, Rutherford & Turrigiano 1999). Realized here as a bounded per-seed calibration of the facilitation gain fac_g (the same Mg-block-gated Tsodyks-Markram facilitation current as the parent GO substrate) toward a fixed target (1.5x FIRE_THR); the search is discretized and safety-bounded because a fresh, self-consistent evaluation of this substrate shows a real non-monotonic cliff at high gain (the pool's own pre-existing intrinsic-excitability homeostat + NMDA-plateau calibration over-compensates), which a blind continuous/proportional controller would walk into.
